what: Ada's move for her own seat names, as its earlier version, Bo's move for his seat at an id Bo signed twice. A row naming an equivocated id as a parent is neither admitted nor reported, on either copy, whichever version of the parent it holds: it neither shows nor hides (review X1). A reader skipping the equivocated parent admits Ada's move; one reading the parent it holds reports SEAT_NOT_HELD. The equivocator is the joiner, so the session stands (R10).
